# Navigation Behavior & Migration Parity Checklist: Navigation 3 Migration

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements for navigation behavior (tabs, back, tab visit history,
state restore) and for migration parity (what stays "as today" and what changes on purpose) are
complete, clear, consistent and measurable. Also check that the spec agrees with the plan and the
contracts.
**Created**: 2026-10-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark
an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: formal PR review gate · **Audience**: reviewer · **Focus**: navigation behavior +
migration parity, with lighter coverage of transitions/predictive back and the developer-facing
FRs.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Does the spec define which tab "owns" a pushed screen (for example, that Device Detail belongs to whichever tab it was opened from), so FR-009's "highlight the tab that owns the current screen" can be evaluated? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the transition style specified for switching tabs from the bottom bar, where the entering and leaving screens have different styles (for example Home → Devices)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements stated for the bottom bar's own show/hide animation when it appears after sign-in, or is today's animation implicitly in the "no regressions" scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 - Does the spec say whether a tab's *first* screen keeps its state after the user backs out of that tab, or only that its deeper history is released? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases "Backing out of a tab"]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the expected starting point defined for relaunching the app after it was left with back from the last tab (Sign In again, or the restored tabs)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §US1-3]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for opening the app from the CO2 alert notification, both while the app is running and after process death (which screen, and whether history is kept)? [Gap, Alternate Flow]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec say whether restoring a signed-in navigation state after process death without signing in again is acceptable? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-010, §US4]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are accessibility parity requirements stated for navigation (tab labels/content descriptions, where screen-reader focus lands after a screen change)? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is "only while the app is in the foreground" (FR-015) defined precisely enough to tell visible-but-not-focused states (dialogs, multi-window) apart from fully interactive ones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "similar duration" in the animation-fidelity assumption bounded with a tolerance (for example, ±N ms of today's 220 ms + 90 ms delay)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions "Animation fidelity"]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "the existing error or empty state" for a device that no longer exists identified concretely, given that today's Device Detail may render nothing when the device is missing? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases "Restoring after process death…"]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "rapid repeated taps" defined for *different* targets (two different device rows tapped quickly), not only the same row or tab? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases "Rapid repeated taps"]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "screen-scoped state" (FR-011) defined clearly enough to tell UI state (scroll position, form text) apart from screen-logic state, given that US2-4 expects the list scroll position to be kept? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §US2-4]
- [ ] CHK014 - Does FR-008's "showing that tab's last screen" state that the previous tab's *state* (not only its screen) is kept, matching FR-006's "with its state kept"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "goes to the background" in US1-3/US3-4 defined as the same outcome as "leaves the app" in FR-008 and the Edge Cases, or do the two terms mean different things? [Ambiguity, Terminology]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Does the spec's navigator contract ("go to, go back, replace all, **switch tab**" in FR-018 and Key Entities) agree with the contract in `contracts/navigator.md`, which has no separate switch-tab intent (switching is `navigate(TopLevelRoute)`)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, Contract]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the "Target libraries" assumption ("to be confirmed against current stable versions during planning") updated to reflect the planning decision to use 1.1.7 rather than the latest stable 1.2.0? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context, Research R1]
- [ ] CHK018 - Does the spec's SDK assumption ("must work with the current … min/target SDK") acknowledge the planned compileSdk 35 → 36 bump? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Research R1]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does the spec say what happens when a tab destination is requested before sign-in, which the plan's rules table decides (`GoTo(Home)` while signed out → ignored, rule R4)? [Gap, Contract navigation-rules R4]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the plan's "replace all to Sign In" capability (rule R20) consistent with the spec's statement that returning to Sign In is out of scope? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions "Sign-out", Contract R20]
- [ ] CHK021 - Do the Context section and FR-002's "back never returns to it" agree with SC-004's wording "Back from Home after sign-in never shows Sign In", now that back from Home can lead to another tab? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §SC-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the "Leaving a screen permanently" edge case consistent with "Backing out of a tab" about which screens' state is released (popped screens only, or the whole tab's history)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Does US3's Independent Test ("check system back behavior from each tab") reflect the clarified tab-visit rule, rather than the earlier "back to Home" wording? [Consistency, Spec §US3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 - Is "the latest supported Android version" in SC-001 pinned to a specific API level, given that predictive back needs API 34+ and the plan names API 36+? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK025 - Do SC-002 and SC-003 state how many attempts make up "100% of attempts"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the "random navigation" session in SC-005 described well enough (action mix, device, build type) to be repeatable by another reviewer? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK027 - Does SC-006's list of rules cover every branch the clarified FR-007/FR-008 introduce (re-visit reorder, removing a tab on back, exit from a non-Home last tab)? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the scope of "80% line coverage of the new logic" (FR-021, SC-006) tied to named units, so it can be measured without interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK029 - Does SC-007's "0 source imports" say whether test sources and the spec documents are included or excluded? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the count of 21 acceptance scenarios in SC-001 still accurate after the clarification edits? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for a navigation request that arrives while a transition or a predictive back gesture is in progress? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the behavior specified when the user switches tabs during an unfinished screen action (for example, Buy Module mid-purchase), and when they come back? [Coverage, Alternate Flow, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK033 - Do the requirements cover config changes that happen while the app is in the background with buffered navigation requests (FR-010 combined with FR-015)? [Coverage, Recovery Flow]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is predictive back behavior at a tab's first screen (a preview of the *previous tab*) stated explicitly, not only "preview the destination"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is predictive back behavior specified for Sign In and for the last remaining tab's first screen, where back leaves the app (a system "back to home" preview vs. no in-app preview)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 - Is the dependency on the manifest predictive-back opt-in recorded as a requirement or assumption, given that FR-014 cannot be met without it (Research R8)? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the assumption that today's tab save/restore "may not work reliably" backed by an observed behavior, so reviewers can tell regressions from intended changes? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions "Tab back behavior"]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the deferred upgrade to navigation3 1.2.x / AGP 9 recorded as known follow-up work, so the version choice is not mistaken for an oversight? [Dependency, Research R1]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Conflict]` or `[Gap]` that the reviewer accepts usually mean a spec edit (or `/speckit-clarify`) before `/speckit-tasks`
